findings.title: Preserve observer state across projects
findings.description: `RunnerTenant` shares one observer across projects, but these lines discard all state absent from the current project’s entries. Observing project B therefore erases project A’s polling timestamps and standing faults. Reproduced: observing A, empty B, then A at the same clock polls A twice despite its 15-second interval. Partition state by project and add a multi-project regression test.

findings.title: Retain unconfirmed-launch faults between polls
findings.description: After an unconfirmed launch returns `PollFailure`, ticks before the next poll bypass `_faulted` and return `LAUNCHING` without replaying the fault. Reproduced at seconds 0 and 1: `FAULT` becomes `LAUNCHING` with no new evidence. Consequently, `ProjectTick._close_recovered` closes the escalation prematurely. Replay standing observation faults here, as the confirmed path does.

findings.title: Recheck the budget immediately before spawning
findings.description: The budget check precedes journaling and log creation, not the subprocess launch. If those operations consume the remaining time—or a stop arrives during them—`Popen` still starts. Reproduced with a journal operation advancing the clock: a deadline of 5 permitted `Popen` at 6 and returned `COMPLETE`. Check the budget at the spawn boundary and explicitly handle an issued entry whose launch is deferred.

structured_findings.summary: Recheck the budget immediately before spawning
